To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
peroxidases can catalyze the oxidation of drugs to reactive metabolites which can react with GSH to produce GSSG.
the peroxidases can catalyze the oxidation of glutathione by a variety of drugs.
the peroxidase-catalyzed oxidation of some drugs in the presence glutathione results in extensive oxidation of glutathione to oxidized glutahione and extensive oxygen uptake.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the metabolism of drugs by the peroxidase catalytic mechanism.
the role of peroxidases, and in particular, the cytochrome P450 system, in the metabolism of certain drugs and the possible formation of toxic metabolites.
the role of glutathione in the metabolism of drugs and other foreign compounds.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
peroxidases catalyse one-electron oxidation reactions with the production of oxygen radicals.
the oxidation of GSH to GSSG is a common feature of peroxidase-catalysed oxidation of drugs, and may also occur with certain cytochrome P450 reactions.

the peroxidase catalysis is not a significant pathway for the metabolism of most drugs in the intact organism, but may be of importance in the metabolism of a small number of drugs, e.g. the phenothiazines.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the peroxidase catalysis of drug metabolism can result in extensive oxidation of GSH, the formation of hydrogen peroxide and thiyl radicals, and a redox cycling of the drug.
the peroxidase catalyzes the oxidation of drugs in the presence GSH, resulting in the oxidation of the drug, the oxidation of GSH, the formation of thiyl radicals and oxygen uptake.
the peroxidase-catalyzed oxidation of drugs in the presence GSH can result in GSSG formation, oxygen consumption and thiyl radical formation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the peroxidase reaction can lead to GSH oxidation and radical formation.
peroxidases can catalyse the oxidation of GSH by drugs and other substrates.
glutathione oxidation is a common feature of peroxidase catalysis of drug oxidation.
